a new approach to the management of plant diseases and to the development of a new generation of plant protection tools.
the development of Information Technology tools for the management of plant diseases and the application of these tools to the protection of olive trees in Salerno.
the application of information technology tools in agriculture, in particular for pest and disease management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, even if the potential applications of Information Technology in agriculture and plant pathology seem to be countless, the real challenge is not in the technology but in the management.
Information Technology is not a “magic wand” that can solve any problem.
Information Technology is a powerful tool to manage plant health issues.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of Information Technology tools to plant health management is not just a matter of “if” but of “how”.
Information Technology can be used to manage the risk of plant diseases, to support the decision-making process, and to provide a new tool for the protection of the plant health and environment.
Information Technologies can help in the management of plant health, but they are not the solution to every problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Information Technology solutions may be a key tool to face the challenges of the future, but they need to be implemented in a context where they are really needed and they can provide real advantages to the stakeholders involved.
, even if there is no single solution for every problem, there are always new opportunities for the application of new technologies in agriculture, especially in the field of plant health.
, in order to achieve the desired results, the use of Information Technology must be supported by an adequate regulatory framework.
